app.description: Control your smart trainer over Bluetooth with a virtual gear shifter, Zwift Cog style.
auto.shiftOn: Shifting follows your cadence: + and − still work
back.background: Press back again: the app goes to the background and keeps recording
backup.confirm.one: Import {count} ride and the file's settings? Your history will be merged ({total} in total).
backup.confirm.other: Import {count} rides and the file's settings? Your history will be merged ({total} in total).
backup.hint: To move from phone to PC (or back): export here, then open the file on the other device with "Import data". History, records, FTP and settings; your Strava login isn't copied.
click.addSecond: Connect the second Zwift Play controller too? (Cancel = disconnect)
clicknav.bar: Click + next · − back · hold + select · hold − go back · + and − exit
clicknav.title: Click menu
coach.hello: Hi! I'm your coach. I'll let you know at every change of pace.
editor.name: Name
editor.summary: Duration {duration} · load {load} · percentages are of your FTP ({ftp} W)
finish.compareSame: Same average power as last time: consistency!
finish.confirmReset: Reset the session? Data not saved to .FIT will be lost.
finish.firstSub: The first step is the most important
finish.garminSaved: File saved to {where}. On Garmin Connect press Browse, choose {file}, then Import Data.
finish.noOpenApp: No app opens .FIT files: use Share
finish.nudge: New game challenges are waiting tomorrow. See you in the saddle.
finish.praise: {mins} minutes in the saddle, {kj} kJ of work.
finish.praiseStart: A great start to the week.
finish.title: Workout complete
games.glow: Glow effects (they switch off by themselves if your phone slows down)
games.gruppetto.desc: New. Pick up the riders who got dropped: they tuck into your slipstream. Don't bump into your own line. The longer the group, the steeper the climb.
games.gruppetto.hud.tagline: Pick up the riders who got dropped.
games.gruppetto.hud.title: GRUPPETTO
games.gruppetto.name: Gruppetto
games.gruppetto.rule1: + turns right · − turns left (hold = keep turning)
games.gruppetto.rule2: Ride over stopped cyclists: they join your line
games.gruppetto.rule3: Don't hit the fence or your own line
games.gruppetto.rule4: The longer the group, the steeper the climb
games.hint: With a trainer connected, recording starts by itself. In a game, your gear stays the one you picked before.
games.horde.desc: A wide road, bigger and bigger hordes: hold + / − to steer, evolve your weapon, grab allies from the portals. More watts = more shots.
games.horde.help: hold + / − to steer · watts = shots · sprint = overdrive
games.horde.hud.title: THE HORDE
games.horde.name: The Horde
games.horde.rule1: You start with a pistol: the waves keep growing
games.horde.rule2: Every kill evolves your weapon (10 weapons)
games.horde.rule3: Blue portals: allies and power-ups. Red ones: avoid them
games.horde.rule4: Hold + / − to steer · more watts = more shots
games.horde.rule5: Get close to the green gems to collect them
games.mattoni.desc: New. 3D brick breaker: your bike is the paddle, cadence is the ball's speed, and a sprint sets it on fire.
games.mattoni.help: hold + / − to move · cadence = ball speed
games.mattoni.hud.title: BRICKS
games.mattoni.name: Bricks
games.mattoni.rule5: You have 3 lives: don't drop the ball
games.planata.desc: New. A pedal-powered plane: watts are your altitude. Rings, ridges to clear and bridges to fly under: an interval workout that doesn't feel like one.
games.planata.hud.title: GLIDE
games.planata.name: Glide
games.planata.rule1: More watts = higher · fewer watts = you descend
games.planata.rule3: Gold rings = points, in a row = combo
games.planata.rule5: Rock bridges: drop your watts and fly under
games.planata.tooHigh: Too high: ease off the watts!
games.progress.ach.allTracks.name: Three for three
games.progress.ach.baron.name: Goodbye Baron
games.progress.ach.combo.name: Combo ×8
games.progress.ach.firstBoss.name: First Bolt

games.progress.ach.win.name: First win
games.progress.daily.draft: Stay in the draft for 60 s
games.racer.desc: Road stages with 8 riders: drafting, coins, items with your sprint, intermediate sprints and king of the mountain. The climbs reach your trainer.
games.racer.hud.title: TURBO PEDALS
games.racer.name: Turbo Pedals 3D
games.racer.rival1.name: Long-legs Larry
games.racer.rival2.name: Turbo Tina
games.racer.rival3.name: Count Chain
games.racer.rival4.name: Brick-wall Mick
games.racer.rival5.name: Lightweight Lia
games.racer.rival6.name: Bottle Bob
games.racer.rival7.name: Auntie Climb
games.racer.stage1.desc: Fast, curves by the sea, short punchy climbs
games.racer.stage1.name: SUNSET COAST
games.racer.stage2.desc: A proper climb: up to 6% on your trainer
games.racer.stage2.name: CLOUD PASS
games.racer.stage3.desc: Ups and downs through the colorful woods
games.racer.stage3.name: AUTUMN HILLS
games.shooter.chargeHint: Sprint above the threshold to charge OVERDRIVE
games.shooter.desc: Side-scrolling shooter: 3 heroes, 3 missions, 5 weapons, prisoners to free, bosses. A sprint triggers OVERDRIVE.
games.shooter.hero.gino.name: GRANDPA GINO
games.shooter.hero.gino.perk: Steel bike from '68: starts with 6 bombs
games.shooter.hero.rocco.name: ROCCO "THE WRENCH"
games.shooter.hero.vale.name: VALE "LIGHTNING"
games.shooter.hud.title: PEDAL STRIKE
games.shooter.inGame: In game: + jump · − bomb · get close: pump shot
games.shooter.missionHint: Free the prisoners, grab weapons, beat the boss!
games.shooter.name: Pedal Strike 3D
games.shooter.story1: Baron Bolt stole the city's bikes
games.shooter.story2: and turned them into robots. Get them back!
games.shooter.story3: Baron Bolt stole the city's bikes.
games.shooter.story4: Get them back, one mission at a time.
games.shooter.title: Pedal Strike
games.title: Games
games.video.desc: A YouTube route or a video of your own that plays at your speed: stop pedaling and it stops. + / − still shift gear.
games.video.help: + / − change gear · the video follows your speed
games.video.name: Ride a video
games.video.title: Video
garmin.broadcast: Send power, cadence and speed to your Garmin
garmin.linked: {name} is paired with your phone through Garmin Connect. To use it as a sensor, disconnect it for a moment:
garmin.nameHint: While it's on, your phone's Bluetooth name is "Spindro"; switch it off and the old name comes back.
garmin.step2: On the Garmin: Sensors & Accessories → Add New → Power, then Speed/Cadence. Pick "Spindro".
garmin.step3: Start an Indoor Bike activity on the Garmin.
garmin.stuck: Garmin stuck on "Connecting"? If your watch is already paired with this phone through Garmin Connect, it often won't open a second connection. On the Garmin, turn off the phone connection for a moment (Settings → Connectivity → Phone), add the sensor, then turn it back on: the activity will sync when you finish.
garmin.unlinkBody: It's paired through Garmin Connect, so it can't pick up the "Spindro" sensor.
garmin.webOnly: Your phone can act as a sensor for your Garmin only in the Android app: download the APK.
history.empty: No rides saved yet. Finish a workout of at least a minute and you'll find it here, with charts and records.
history.ftpGuess: From your best 20 minutes your estimated FTP is {ftp} W (set: {current} W).
history.ftpHelp: Ride at least 20 minutes at a steady effort (or do the FTP test in Workouts) to get an FTP estimate.
history.title: History
history.weeksNote: Minutes ridden over the last 8 weeks.
home.gearNote: Gear 12/24 · ratio - · use − and + below or the Click
home.keyboard: Keyboard: <kbd>←</kbd> <kbd>→</kbd> or <kbd>−</kbd> <kbd>+</kbd> change gear · <kbd>Space</kbd> start / pause · <kbd>G</kbd> games · in games, hold the arrows to steer.
home.unsupported: This browser can't do Bluetooth. On PC and Mac use Chrome or Edge; on Android use Chrome or the app; on iPhone use the Bluefy app.
music.hint: Long press (almost 1 second) on + = next track, on − = play / pause. A short press still shifts gear. Works with Spotify, YouTube Music, podcasts and any app playing in the background.
music.title: Music
music.webOnly: Available in the Android app: a browser can't control other apps.
pm.hint: Garmin Rally or Vector pedals, Favero Assioma, cranks with Bluetooth power. The trainer still controls the resistance.
pm.title: Power meter
pm.use: Use its watts and cadence instead of the trainer's
report.hint: Opens a GitHub issue pre-filled with the app version and device type. No personal data.
route.firstTime: Time: {time}. Next time you can race this record!
route.noElevation: The GPX has no elevation data: riding it flat
routes.colle.desc: 8 km uphill, 5.5% average with a stretch at 9%
routes.colle.name: Test climb
routes.intro: Load a GPX file (export it from Strava, Komoot, Garmin Connect…): the grade follows the track, and the track goes into the .FIT file, so you get the map on Strava.
routes.onde.desc: 20 km of short ups and downs, great for practicing your gears
routes.onde.name: Rolling hills
routes.piano.name: Lakeside
routes.title: Routes
settings.autoPause: Auto start and pause when you pedal or stop
settings.coach: Voice coach: announces intervals, climbs and milestones
settings.ftpHint: FTP colors the power zones; weight matters for the virtual gears.
settings.languageHint: Language of the app and the coach's voice.
settings.title: Settings
share.notYoutube: The shared link isn't a YouTube video
share.received: Video received: pedal to make it play
share.title: {mins} minutes in the saddle
strava.activityDesc: Indoor trainer workout with Spindro. Average power {watts} W, {kj} kJ, {km} km.
strava.already: Already uploaded: open on Strava
strava.alreadyOn: Already on Strava. Open the activity
strava.autoUpload: When you finish, your ride goes to Strava by itself.
strava.badCreds: Check your Client ID (numbers only) and Client Secret (long string).
strava.connectHint: Connect Strava in settings to upload automatically.
strava.duplicate: This workout is already on Strava
strava.err.credentials: Enter your Client ID and Client Secret first
strava.err.scope: Permission to upload activities is needed: try again and leave the box ticked
strava.err.state: Invalid response from Strava (state mismatch), try again
strava.pending: Uploaded: Strava is still processing it, it will show up shortly
strava.step1: Create an application at strava.com/settings/api, website .
strava.step3: Paste your Client ID and Client Secret here. They stay on this device.
strava.uploadFailed: Strava error: {error}. The .FIT file is still available via "Save .FIT file".
video.drm: Netflix, Prime Video and the like can't be shown inside another app (content protection): use your phone's split screen, and control the music from the Click (Settings → Music).
video.howApp: From the YouTube app: open the video, tap Share and pick Spindro: you're back here and the video starts by itself.
video.howWeb: From YouTube: open the video, tap Share → Copy link, come back here and tap Paste link.
video.intro: Paste the link of a YouTube video of a bike route (search for "cycling 4K" or "virtual ride", for example), or pick a video from your device. The video plays at your speed.
video.noTrainer: Trainer not connected: the video plays at normal speed
video.refSpeed: Speed the video was filmed at:
video.ytError: YouTube doesn't allow this video to be shown here (error {code}). Try another one.
watch.aria: Watch: hold the top-left button, then choose Phone
watch.missing: Can't see the Phone icon? Add it in Settings → Controls on your watch.
watch.step1: On {name} hold the LIGHT button (top left) to open the controls.
watch.step3: The phone shows as disconnected: now {name} can pair with "Spindro". When you finish, repeat the same gesture to reconnect it and sync.
welcome.step1: Connect your trainer with the "Trainer" tile above
welcome.step2: Pick a mode: with Gears you use virtual gears
welcome.step3: Press Start and pedal: − and + change gear
welcome.subtitle: Three steps and you're riding.
welcome.title: Ready to ride?
workout.connectHint: Connect your trainer: the workout starts anyway
workout.ftpFound: Best minute: {best} W. Your estimated FTP is {ftp} W (was {old} W). Save it?
workout.testTooShort: Test too short to estimate your FTP
workouts.fitHint: Copy it to your watch in GARMIN/NewFiles (USB) or import it into intervals.icu
workouts.fondo.desc: Aerobic endurance: the base of everything. Conversation pace.
workouts.fondo.name: Easy endurance
workouts.heading: Workouts
workouts.intro: The trainer sets the watts for each step from your FTP (200 W — change it in Settings or with the test). During a workout, + and − raise or lower the intensity by 5%.
workouts.piramide.desc: Go up and down in intensity: 1-2-3-4-3-2-1 minutes, equal recoveries.
workouts.piramide.name: Pyramid
workouts.ramp.desc: Start easy and every minute add 20 W until you can't hold on. Your FTP = 75% of your best minute. Stop pedaling (or press End) when you're at your limit.
workouts.ramp.name: Ramp FTP test
workouts.sblocco.desc: Light legs with a few short accelerations. Ideal the day after a hard effort.
workouts.sblocco.name: Openers
workouts.soglia.desc: Two efforts at your FTP. Raises the ceiling of your sustainable power.
workouts.soglia.name: Threshold 2×15
workouts.sweet.desc: Three blocks just below threshold: the best trade-off between effort and progress.
workouts.sweet.name: Sweet spot 3×10
workouts.title: Workouts and routes
workouts.trenta.desc: 2 sets of 8 × 30 seconds hard and 30 easy. Short but intense.
workouts.vo2.desc: Short, hard intervals to enlarge the engine.
workouts.vo2.name: VO2max 5×3
workouts.zwoHint: Import it into intervals.icu, TrainingPeaks or Zwift
